explain XXXXX in english without using word XXXXX

for context here, the concept of XXXXXness is defined as the impossibility of any possible meaning or context for an utterance of the words used in a sentence or statement, according to the context. consider, for example, the sentence "i don't see any point" to be a sentence in this sense. but on reading it, the sentence is understood differently from its context. i don't see any point, i see "point". that is to say, there is an XXXXX meaning for the sentence in this context, whereas in the context of a different sentence, the sentence is understood to mean "no point at all".
that example has been used to illustrate various types of XXXXXness. i have explained earlier in my answer to this question that in this sense, a sentence is said to be "incompact" when there is no way that i can deduce in any possible way the meaning or context of a sentence from its context; i.e.,

"the two boys were the first ones to come and the second ones to go" is in this sense, an XXXXX sentence; but "two boys were the first ones to come and second ones to go" is not, since the context tells me no possible way
